what: Pull to refresh on Ghar: drag down, the roti flips on the tawa, 'Chhodo, roti palat do', let go, it spins while it refreshes, 'Garam garam'. The pull is synthetic touch events (eval), because clip.mjs swipes are mouse drags and the pull listens for touch only. The pull pauses three times on the way down so the mid-flip posters are of a held frame.
Tap the thali on the locked hero: steam puffs rise off the dish. Tapped twice.
A mistaken tap hands the baari to Papa; the calmer undo bar 'Ab Papa ki baari · Wapas lo' with its 4 s haldi line; Wapas lo puts it back.
Offline: ?offline drops the network after the first load. After about 5 s the island reads 'Offline · 6 min purana' and its ring turns red.

Onboarding end to end on a fixture: all 10 scenes with the island's verbs on every tap, the coin spin (CA10), typed rule instead of the mic, the six-language karaoke brief (CA12), the dry run, the emoji burst. Stills scene1 to scene10 for the deck.
The splash on a fixture (&splash). The splash lasts about 1 s and is gone before clip.mjs starts recording, so the page reloads itself once inside the take and the splash plays from load.
The soft tap dip on the nav tabs (held 250 ms so the 0.85 dip reads), then Ghar scrolled slowly so the cards slide under the blurred top and bottom edges.

A fresh household with no fixture: '/' opens onboarding for real, walked quickly through every scene to the last one. Rails is unreachable from the recording container, so this records up to where the first network write would go out.

Kitchen TV reveal: shortlist with a 10 s ring (?t=10), S turns sound on, space starts the ring, it runs out ('Bas, lock ho raha hai'), then the lock lands: drumroll between the two dishes, the Locked stamp on Rajma chawal, the food burst. On a fixture the TV never locks by itself (fixtures load once), so the lock is the lock fixture loaded into a fresh copy of tv.js on the same page (eval, see PR). The join QR is drawn by the first eval (shots/tv/helper.mjs) because its library sits on cdnjs, which this container can't reach.

The phone beside the TV reveal: the locked hero (lock fixture) building in on load, 'Pakka', Rajma chawal. For the TV pair (CV02 stamp | app hero). The app has no stamp of its own; the sync point is the hero's last entrance still.

Kitchen TV in vote (shortlist fixture): Rajma chawal vs Lauki chana dal, the 1/3 meter, the faces with the crown on Mummy (first voter), the ring counting down, the join QR. The QR is drawn by the first eval (helper.mjs, cdnjs is blocked here).

Kitchen TV footer (shortlist fixture): the 6-day voting streak, whose baari it is (Vinay, 'Tie hua toh yahi todenge'), the join QR with 'Phone se vote karo'. The lock state's 'Mummy ki baari kal' is in CV02's locked still. QR drawn by the first eval (helper.mjs).
